title: Traditional Chinese and English: script, terms and facts in the reader's language
notes: Five zh-Hant and five English turns, two of them follow-ups. Free museum days in English are covered by A/C14, so the English set carries a Fleet Week follow-up instead.

turns.message: 灣區這週末有什麼免費的親子活動？

gold.goldEntity: 這週末（10/10–11）免費親子活動，如 Santa Clara 圖書館 Comic Con

judge.expect: 繁體中文。按這週末 10/10–11 給 2–3 個站內免費親子活動（附地點、時間、條件），用台灣/香港讀者看得懂的用語。
繁體中文。延續這週末、免費、親子，給室內備案（圖書館活動、免費博物館時段等站內資料）；不編造活動或價格。

turns.message: 我媽 68 歲住舊金山，長者坐公車有優惠卡嗎？

gold.goldEntity: sfmta-free-muni-seniors（長者免費 Muni，按收入）與長者 Clipper

judge.expect: 繁體中文。65 歲以上可辦長者 Clipper 卡享優惠；舊金山低收入長者可申請 Free Muni；說明申請方式與證件，不要求在聊天裡提供證件號碼。

turns.message: 加州駕照筆試可以考中文嗎？要先預約嗎？

judge.expect: 繁體中文。說明筆試可選中文（以 DMV 官方語言清單為準）、路考需預約，給 DMV 官方入口；簡潔。

turns.message: 房東要我先匯 500 元訂金才能看房，可以嗎？

gold.firstSentence: 不要|別|不建議|詐騙|騙|風險|不可以|不靠譜|不可靠

judge.expect: 繁體中文。結論先行：看房前先匯訂金是典型詐騙訊號，不要匯；給 2–3 個核驗方法，引用站內防騙指南。

turns.message: Anything free for kids in Oakland on Saturday?

judge.expect: English. Free kid-friendly Oakland options for Sat 10/10 grounded in site records (e.g., Chabot free telescope viewing, Lake Merritt, library events); say plainly what is not listed rather than inventing events or prices.

turns.message: How do I get a library card in Fremont?

gold.goldEntity: Everyday free perks guide: Fremont is served by AC Library (eCard, physical card)

judge.expect: English. Fremont is served by Alameda County Library: get an eCard online, then a physical card at a branch with name and California address proof for printing and full services; never share card number or PIN in chat.

turns.message: When is Fleet Week in San Francisco this year?

gold.goldEntity: San Francisco Fleet Week 2026 (Oct 4-12, air show Oct 9-11)

judge.expect: English. Fleet Week runs Oct 4-12, 2026; the air show is Oct 9-11, 12:00-16:00; ship tours and parade details from the site record.

turns.message: Is it free to watch from Marina Green?

judge.expect: English. Yes, general admission at Marina Green is free; VIP viewing is ticketed; bring layers and ear protection for kids, take transit.

turns.message: A landlord wants a $500 deposit before showing me the apartment. Is that normal?

judge.expect: English. Lead with the conclusion: paying before a showing is a classic rental scam sign; do not pay; give 2-3 ways to verify the landlord and listing.
